photos.caption: Autumn
photos.description: A quiet path winds through trees covered in autumn leaves.

photos.caption: Listening to Music
photos.description: A dark tabletop holds over-ear headphones, wired earbuds, charging cases, and small portable players. The mix of cables, batteries, and compact devices traces how recorded music moves from a retro cassette deck to everyday listening.

photos.caption: Downtown San Diego
photos.description: Downtown San Diego shifts between bright waterfront lights and the soft gray of the marine layer. High-rises, palm-lined streets, and wet pavement hold the city in a moody coastal atmosphere, whether the skyline is glowing after dark or disappearing into low clouds.

photos.caption: Rainlit Drive
photos.description: A night drive unfolds behind rain-streaked glass, with brake lights, streetlamps, and wet pavement dissolving into red and amber reflections. From the quiet passenger seat to the open road ahead, the city feels distant, enclosed, and slow.

photos.caption: I AM MUSIC
photos.description: I AM MUSIC BY PLAYBOI CARTI

photos.caption: Night Walk
photos.description: Two silhouettes walk down a wet wooden path toward a lively city intersection at night. Streetlights, headlights, and glowing windows gather around the dark figures, turning an ordinary walk into a quiet view of the city after sunset.

photos.caption: Lantern hour
photos.description: Dusk settling in, warm glow illuminating the evening as the day winds down.

photos.caption: Hard light
photos.description: Sharp contrasts created by the unforgiving midday sun, highlighting every detail.

photos.caption: Edge of water
photos.description: Where the land meets the calm surface, reflecting the sky in a perfect mirror.
